data.name: Zero Carbon Systems
data.description: Zero Carbon Systems is a US-based direct air capture company that acquired Global Thermostat in May 2024, combining Global Thermostat's solid-sorbent DAC core technology with Zero Carbon Systems' engineering design. The company plans to own and operate a 2,500-ton per year demonstration plant in 2025-2026, a 50,000-ton commercial plant two years later, and a million-ton scale plant by around 2030. The firm is funded primarily by founder David Elenowitz's investment vehicle Zero Carbon Partners.
